parameters.query:
SELECT c.chunk_index, c.chapter_title AS chapter, c.page_number AS page, c.content,
       count(*) OVER () AS total
FROM teachers_manager.book_chunks c
JOIN teachers_manager.book_sources b ON b.id = c.book_id
WHERE c.book_id = $1::uuid AND b.teacher_id = $2::uuid
ORDER BY c.chunk_index
OFFSET $3::integer LIMIT $4::integer;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, data: { chunks: $json.chunks, total: $json.total, offset: $json.offset } }) }}
